document_meta.title: Varni Jewels Brand Command Center - Project Handout

art_direction.design_rationale: Dark mode conveys the premium, tech-forward nature of the Varni Jewels AI command center. Triadic harmony with amber base hue mirrors the brand's gold identity while the green accent adds a modern data-driven feel. Continuous flow creates visual continuity across all pages.

components.label: Covering Every Aspect of Brand Operations

components.markdown_content:
### Core Framework
**Next.js 16** with App Router powers the entire platform. **React 19** drives the UI layer with **TypeScript** for type safety. **Tailwind CSS 4** handles all styling with OKLCH color space for precision.

### UI & Data Layer
**shadcn/ui** provides 40+ Radix-based components. **Recharts** renders all data visualizations. **React Context** manages Auth, Workspace, and Action state. **React Hook Form + Zod** power form validation.

### Advanced Libraries
**Framer Motion** for animations. **TanStack Table** for data grids. **TanStack Query** for async state. **dnd-kit** for drag-and-drop. **MDX Editor** for rich content.

### Data Architecture
**38 mock data exports** power all modules with realistic jewelry-industry metrics. **Prisma + SQLite** ready for production API integration. localStorage enables session persistence with SSR hydration guards.

### Brand Health
**Brand Overview** - Score 78/100, 8 KPI cards, health trend tracking
**Brand Awareness** - ToM 28%, aided recall 67%, share of voice 18.4%
**Sentiment & Listening** - 10K mentions, 72 net sentiment, buzz analysis
**Customer Experience** - NPS 62, CSAT 87, 8 touchpoint scores

### Commerce & Inventory
**Sales Intelligence** - 6 categories, 7 materials, bestseller tracking
**Inventory Intelligence** - 2,840 SKUs, $4.2M value, dead stock alerts
**Revenue & Funnel** - $2.84M revenue, 3.2% conversion, 5-stage funnel
**Loyalty & Retention** - 68K members, 4 tiers, 42% repeat rate

### Marketing Operations
**Marketing Command** - $185K spend, $740K revenue, 4.0 ROAS
**WhatsApp Hub** - 142K contacts, $486K revenue, AI replies
**Creative & Brand** - 248 creatives, 7 visual styles, fatigue tracking
**Email & SMS** - 245K list, 34.2% open rate, 6 automations
**Influencer & PR** - 18 partnerships, 5.2 ROI, partner analytics

### Audience & Digital Presence
**Audience & Personas** - Demographic segmentation, buying behavior
**Customer Journey** - Full funnel mapping, drop-off analysis
**Social Media** - 892K followers across 5 platforms
**Content Strategy** - 156 pieces, 4.8% engagement, calendar view
**SEO & Digital** - 185K organic traffic, 342 keywords, DA 62
**Landing Page Builder** - AI-generated pages, A/B testing, conversion tracking

### Intelligence & Command Centers
**Competitive Intel** - 8.4% market share, 5 competitor tracking
**Campaign Calendar** - 8 seasonal campaigns, pipeline management
**Paid Ads Command** - 24/7 audit, bid management, waste analysis ($8.7K)
**SEO Command** - Technical crawl, content decay, keyword gaps
**ClickFlow Engine** - 30 articles/month automated content pipeline

### AI Growth Engine
Momentum score 82 with 6 daily AI suggestions. 7-day growth playbook with 6 actionable steps. 5 predicted insights for proactive decision-making. Intelligent trend analysis across all modules.

### AI Creative Studio
AI-powered ad creative generation. Learning from winning patterns. Platform-specific format suggestions. Approval workflow with creative analysis. Continuous A/B testing automation.

### Agency Command
Multi-client management across 4 brand verticals. Batch audit capabilities. White-label report generation. Health score tracking per project. Client portal access for stakeholders.

### Slack & Teams Bot
Natural language queries inside chat. Conversational campaign modifications. Inline approval workflows. Automated daily summaries. One-click report generation.

### Free Audit & Leads
Email-to-audit pipeline delivers results within 1 hour. Automated lead capture and qualification. Competitive benchmarking included. Actionable optimization recommendations.

### Action Modals
**Create Campaign** - Name, type, channels, budget, dates, audience, objectives
**Send Broadcast** - WhatsApp/Email/SMS blast to 142K contacts with scheduling
**Create Segment** - Dynamic rules engine with AND logic, 6 filter fields
**Create Workflow** - Automation triggers (cart abandon, purchase, win-back, birthday)
**Export Data** - CSV/JSON with column picker and preview
**Schedule Post** - Multi-platform social media scheduling

### Smart Automations
1. Auto-Reorder Alerts for low-stock items
2. Smart Liquidation for dead inventory
3. Cart Abandonment Recovery sequences
4. Content Decay Auto-Fix for SEO
5. Budget Auto-Adjust across ad platforms
6. Post-Purchase NPS surveys
7. Win-Back Auto-Trigger for churned users
8. Creative Fatigue Auto-Rotate
9. Restock WhatsApp Alerts
10. Sentiment Spike Alerts

### 4 Brand Verticals
**Varni Jewels** (Gold #D4A843) - Fine Jewelry, $185K/mo budget
**Varni Diamonds** (Purple #8B5CF6) - Diamond Retail, $120K/mo
**Varni Watches** (Blue #0EA5E9) - Luxury Watches, $65K/mo
**Varni Home** (Emerald #10B981) - Home Decor, $25K/mo (Paused)

Each project has independent modules, budgets, team assignments, and brand-colored dashboards.

### Role-Based Access Control
**Owner** - Full permissions, team management
**Admin** - Create/Edit/Delete/Export/Manage
**Editor** - Create/Edit/Export content
**Analyst** - View all modules, export data
**Viewer** - Read-only access

### Authentication
Secure login with localStorage session persistence. Demo credentials pre-filled (info@varnijewels.com). SSR hydration guard prevents flash. Google and Microsoft SSO ready.
